name: Default
shortDescription: Realtime bird and wildlife sound identification with local AI models, fed by RTSP, HTTP or HLS audio streams, with a web dashboard.

alerts.message: The web UI and its settings are open to anyone until you enable a password in Settings > Security. Do this right after the first visit.

No sound card is passed to the container. Add a network audio stream, such as an IP camera or a network microphone: the first-run wizard takes an RTSP URL, and Settings > Audio also accepts RTMP, HTTP and HLS streams.
